minutes.headline: Sewer Commission accepted a Kimball Street sewer extension pending a licensed drain layer and backed an ARPA request.
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission heard a plan for a short sewer extension on Kimball Street off Prospect Street and accepted it on condition that a licensed contractor is assigned. It also discussed a possible illegal connection at Sunny Hill Road and a plan to ask for ARPA money for manhole and pump station work. It voted to abate a bankruptcy-discharged debt, and the business manager announced her retirement.

votes.outcome: passed; the chair said the motion was accepted after members voted in favor

votes.motion: Abate past-due sewer bills at 24 John Street per the Chapter 7 bankruptcy order of discharge.

budget_items.what_was_said: The commission planned to ask the town for ARPA money to repair manholes and cut infiltration. The ask was set at a round figure.

budget_items.topic: ARPA request for pump station upgrades
budget_items.what_was_said: Members suggested adding pump station upgrades to the request, since some stations are about 25 years old. One member suggested splitting the ask between pumps and manholes.
figures_as_heard: two and two two for the pump stations and two for the manholes

budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked whether ARPA money could replenish pump station spare parts. The DPW director had not seen anything on this in the federal rule and will look further.

Indirect costs were budgeted for a full-time employee from December, but the hire started mid-March, so some was transferred out. The business manager asked whether to pursue credit for fringe benefit costs during the DPW director vacancy.
Past-due sewer bills at one property were abated under a Chapter 7 discharge order.
The July counsel invoice was high because of work on a connection fee moratorium and remote meeting guidance. It is an automatic journal transfer, so no adjustment is possible.
The Fitchburg invoice for May 26 through June 25 will be put through. Charges are declining in a dry summer.
figures_as_heard: fifteen thousand two hundred twenty three dollars and seven cents

budget_items.what_was_said: Progress on the new billing system has paused while billing goes out. It is expected back on the agenda on August 30.

decisions.decision: The business manager will request that someone representing 400 Sunny Hill Road attend the next meeting.
The DPW director will put together a short ARPA request covering manholes and pump stations for the Select Board meeting the following week.
The commission gave the business manager its support, without a vote, to pursue a credit for indirect costs during the DPW director vacancy.
Approval of the minutes was put off until the next meeting for lack of members who attended both.
Another commissioner would receive the link to the August 30 counsel hours.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission accepted a short sewer extension at 4 Kimball Street, on condition that a licensed contractor or drain layer is assigned.
The commission voted to abate past-due sewer bills at 24 John Street, following a Chapter 7 bankruptcy order of discharge.
The DPW director will prepare a short ARPA request for manhole and pump station work, for the Select Board meeting the following week.
The commission discussed a possible illegal connection at 400 Sunny Hill Road and asked that someone representing the property attend the next meeting.
Approval of the minutes was put off for lack of members who attended both meetings, and the business manager announced her retirement.

why_it_matters: The ARPA request, if the Select Board grants it, would pay for sewer manhole and pump station repairs from federal relief money rather than from sewer rates.
The commission also asked about a credit for indirect costs during the DPW director vacancy, a question of which budget carries staffing costs, and no vote was taken on it.
watch_next: The Select Board meeting the following week, where the DPW director's ARPA request for manholes and pump stations is due.
The commission's August 30 meeting, where the new billing system is expected back on the agenda.
